title: Optional large model for triage and auto labels
steps: On a Mac that once downloaded Qwen3 1.7B in Mail, open Settings › AI
Look at Model for each feature › Triage and auto labels
expected: Triage and auto labels uses Apple on-device model (default); Qwen3.5 9B OptiQ (4-bit) is listed and greyed out as not downloaded. The section warns about 7.1 GB of disk and 8 GB of memory before the download button, and lists Qwen3 1.7B with its size and a Delete button; its files stay until you click Delete.
